candidate.blueprint_locator: 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan, Management of Care, printed p.7 / PDF p.11
candidate.educational_objective: Explain the patient-safety and engagement purpose of bedside shift report.

options.A: It supports a safe handoff while allowing the client and family to participate in and clarify information about care.
options.B: It eliminates the need for the incoming nurse to assess the client.
options.C: It prevents the client from asking questions during shift change.
options.D: It replaces all other documentation and handoff communication.

candidate.rationale: AHRQ’s bedside shift report strategy is designed to support a safe transfer of information and responsibility at shift change while involving the patient and family in the handoff when appropriate. It supplements rather than replaces nursing assessment and documentation.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Bedside shift report supports successful information transfer and patient/family engagement at shift change.
candidate.source_locator: Purpose of bedside shift report—safe handoff with patient/family engagement
candidate.source_organization: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality
candidate.stem: Which benefit best explains why bedside shift report is performed with the client present when appropriate and desired?
